settings.title: Settings
settings.boardsHint: Connected tools. Tap one to edit it.
settings.refreshHint: While the app is open. In the background iOS decides when, so alerts can be late.

connections.orSignIn: Or sign in with your {{account}} account, no token needed:
connections.signInAgain: Signed out, or never signed in on this phone? Sign in:
connections.signInApproval: If {{app}} asks for an admin’s approval (a “Request” button) and you don’t want to wait, connect with an API token above instead.
connections.deviceCode: Enter this code on {{app}} (it’s copied). The board is added once you have.
connections.pickProviderHint: Pick the tool to pull your tasks from.
connections.nameHint: The name on the tab. Left empty, it comes from the site address.
connections.removeDescription: The board and its saved API token are deleted from this device. Tasks at the source are untouched.
connections.secretKept: Saved: {{hint}}. Enter a new one to replace it; leave empty to keep it.

errors.unauthorized: Sign-in was refused. I stopped retrying so your account isn't locked; edit the connection and update the details.
errors.notFound: Site not found. Check the {{app}} address.
errors.network: Couldn't connect. Check your internet connection.
errors.rateLimited: {{app}}'s request limit was reached. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalidInput: Details are missing or wrong. Edit the connection.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this in {{app}}.
errors.captcha: {{app}} locked sign-in behind a CAPTCHA. Sign in to {{app}} once in your browser to pass it, then press Retry.
errors.blocked: Your company's network security blocked this request. You can do it in {{app}}; for a lasting fix, ask your security team to allow {{app}} API access.
errors.keychain: The iOS Keychain wasn't reachable. Unlock the device and try again.

welcome.title: Welcome to AssignedToMe
welcome.body: Every task assigned to you, from all your boards, in one place.

boards.title: Connect your boards
boards.body: Every tool you connect becomes a board, and your tasks refresh on their own; pick how often in Settings.

providers.title: Works with your tools
providers.body: See your tasks from Jira, Linear, GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps in one list.

privacy.title: Your keys stay with you
privacy.body: API keys stay in this device's Keychain and go only to the tool they belong to.

notify.title: Stay in the loop
notify.body: Get notified when a task is assigned to you. iOS asks for permission next.

desktop.title: Using it on your Mac?
desktop.body: Bring your boards over without new tokens: on the Mac, open Settings → Send to phone and scan its QR here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyDescription: When a task is assigned to you on a connected board, it shows up here.

tasks.signInAgain: This sign-in has ended, or hasn’t happened on this phone yet. Sign in to see its tasks.
tasks.emptyTitle: Nothing open is assigned to you
tasks.emptyDescription: Connect a board and the tasks assigned to you gather here.
tasks.errorUnauthorized: The API token was rejected. It may have expired; add a new one.
tasks.title: AssignedToMe
tasks.noBoardsDescription: Tasks assigned to you across your boards gather in one list.
tasks.noTransitions: No status changes available for this task.
tasks.undoUnavailable: Can't move back to {{status}} from here. Change it in {{app}}.
tasks.noWorkLogs: No time logged on this task yet.
tasks.leavesList: It's no longer yours, so it leaves your list on the next refresh.
tasks.noResultsHint: Try a task key (FEMBS3-2750 or 2750), a title or a person.
tasks.thumbnailOnly: The full-size image couldn't be downloaded; showing the thumbnail. Open in Jira for full size.
tasks.typeToFindMore: Can't find someone? Type their name.

filters.title: Filters
filters.noMatchHint: Remove a filter or clear them all.

detail.epicEmpty: No issues in this epic yet.

comments.title: Comments
comments.deleteDescription: It's removed from {{app}} for good and can't be undone.

transfer.signInNeeded: Boards added with a sign-in need you to sign in on this phone: open the board’s tab.
transfer.signInNote_one: {{count}} board was added with a sign-in. It goes without it, and the Mac asks you to sign in once.
transfer.signInNote_other: {{count}} boards were added with a sign-in. They go without it, and the Mac asks you to sign in once.
transfer.receiveStep: On your Mac, open Settings → Send to phone and enter this code. Then scan the QR it shows.
transfer.cameraNeeded: The camera is used only to scan the QR on your Mac.
transfer.sendStep: On your Mac, open Settings → Receive from phone. Enter the code it shows here.
transfer.copied: Copied. Paste it on your Mac within 10 minutes.
transfer.wrongCode: This QR was made for a different code. On the Mac, start again with the code shown here.
transfer.expired: This transfer is older than 10 minutes. Make a new one.
transfer.invalid: This isn't an AssignedToMe transfer QR.
transfer.noBoards: Nothing to add: these boards use tools this version doesn't know.
